name: Legacy security default: TLS 1.0 still accepted (legacy compat)

input.title: TLS 1.0 still accepted for backward compat with embedded devices
input.summary: Server accepts TLS 1.0 because enterprise customers have legacy POS terminals. Spec §18: legacy_security_default — intentional, documented, will deprecate in v4.0.

rationale: Per Spec §18: legacy_security_default. Documented intent, planned removal in v4.0. disposition_reason=hardening_only.
